Put your Skylanders figure dumps in this folder (sub-folders are fine, two levels deep).

Each file must be a raw 1024-byte MIFARE 1K dump of the toy (.bin, .dump, .sky, .dmp or
no extension). Dump your own figures with a Proxmark, ACR122U, Flipper Zero (export as .bin),
an NFC phone app that saves raw 1K dumps, or a real portal with SkyReader on a PC.

The file name (without extension) is what the on-screen menu shows, so name them nicely:
  Spyro.bin
  Giants\Tree Rex.bin
  Trap Team\Traps\Kaos Trap.bin
  SuperChargers\Hot Streak.bin

The game's progress is written back into these files. The first time a file is changed, the
original is copied to SkyPortal\Backups\ (never overwritten), so you can always go back.
